id.description: Unique identifier for the logical object that instance of this type represents.

name.description: The name of the component. Optional field for informational purposes only.

dataSpec.description:
The data settings for this component.

@uiSdlDesignerCustomRenderer(rendererType='')

disableDataRequestOnFirstRender.description: Disable if you want to avoid sending any and all requests for this component on first render.

triggersRegistered.description: Whether the effect triggers and epics have been registered

wrapWithMetadataId.description: Whether to wrap the component with a div which has a class name of its metdata id. Useful for targeting with css.

height.description: The height of the component in pixels.

data.description:
Incoming data for the visualization. Must be in JSON format for the downstream React component to be able to
handle it cleanly.

columnNames.description:
The columns from the data frame. These will be used to generate the columns for the grid representation of the
visualization.

sourceType.description:
Required if an #evalMetricsSpec or an #evalSpec is provided. Not required if #data is
provided.

evalMetricsSpec.description:
An alternative to passing in #data to the visualization. If an `evalMetricsSpec` is provided, the
visualization will make it's own `evalMetrics` call after initial render to populate the visualization. This
also requires a #sourceType to be provided.

evalSpec.description:
An alternative to passing in #data to the visualization. If an `evalSpec` is provided, the
visualization will make it's own `eval` call after initial render to populate the visualization. This
also requires a #sourceType to be provided.

sourceRelation.description: The {@link Genai.Query.ResultToSourceRelation} created for the spec that this visualization is generated on.

dynamicData.description: The {@link Genai.Agent.DynamicData} containing the data to be visualized.

latitude.description: A reference to the column/field name in the #data that should be used as the latitude for each map marker.

longitude.description: A reference to the column/field name in the #data that should be used as the longitude for each map marker.

tooltipConfig.description: Configuration for the tooltips that render on click of each map marker

title: A UI component used to render markers on a map nested within a {@link GenAiUiVisualizationContainer}
name: GenAiUiSearchResultMap
